verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway offers automatic failover to other providers on request failure (docs-3), per-provider timeouts for fast failover (docs-10), and BYOK fallback to system credentials on failure (docs-13), which functionally covers transient-error resilience. However, there is no explicit 'retry policy' configuration (e.g., retry counts, backoff, error-code filters) documented—only ordering/sorting of providers and automatic failover, so control over retry behavior is limited.
